places-izquierda-e-de-santonje-solana-de.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-izquierda-e-de-santonje-solana-de.story: From María it runs 319 km to María; allow about 5 h 30 of riding. The stops in between: Abrigo de la fuente, Andragulla I, Cueva del Gitano and Solana del molinico. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.

core-forgotten-world-and-taranaki-ring.story: The remote SH43 corridor extended into a complete Taranaki and King Country loop. The road: SH43, SH3 and Taranaki local roads. Distance and riding time are estimates from the checkpoints until the road is measured on this page.
